svg.aria-label: NetOps Sentinel: two routers and two hosts under Prometheus monitoring. When R1 goes down, an alert opens an incident, the engine collects evidence, an AI model suggests a cause and a human decides
svg.text: a network lab that notices when something breaks
Simulator UI online. Live version coming next.
Healthy. Traffic flows between the two LANs and Prometheus keeps scraping.
Prometheus raises an alert and the API opens an incident.
The engine collects evidence and an AI model suggests a cause.
You decide and fix it. The AI changes nothing.
